scanErrors.invalidCredentials: Registry authentication failed. Check the credential's access key/secret.
scanErrors.missingCredentials: No registry credential was provided for this image.
scanErrors.tokenExpired: The registry token expired. Retry; if it persists, re-save the credential.
scanErrors.forbidden: Access to the registry is forbidden (403). Check the credential's permissions.
scanErrors.ecrAccess: AWS ECR access denied. Verify the IAM role/trust policy, External ID, account and region.
scanErrors.gcrAccess: Google GCR access denied. Check the credential and its permissions.
scanErrors.acrAccess: Azure ACR access denied. Check the credential and its permissions.
scanErrors.imageNotFound: Image not found. Verify the image name and tag exist in the registry.
scanErrors.manifest: Could not read the image manifest. The image may be corrupt or unsupported.
scanErrors.layer: Could not download the image layers. Please retry.
scanErrors.oom: The scanner ran out of memory while scanning this image.
scanErrors.timeout: The scan timed out before completing. Please retry.
scanErrors.imagePull: Could not pull the image. Check the image name/tag and that the credential is linked to this project.
scanErrors.podLost: The scan was interrupted. Please retry.
scanErrors.queueTimeout: This scan waited too long for a free scan slot and was cancelled. You can start it again.
scanErrors.sourceFetch: We could not download the repository from your Git provider. Check that the integration is still connected and that the branch exists.
scanErrors.sourceRateLimited: Your Git provider rate-limited the repository download. Please retry in a few minutes.
scanErrors.sourceInvalid: We could not process the repository archive. It may be too large or not a valid archive.
scanErrors.writesBlocked: This scan was cancelled before it started: your organization's AppSec Platform is no longer active or its plan is unpaid.
scanErrors.trialScansExhausted: This scan did not start: your organization's trial has used all of its scans. An administrator or a billing manager can choose a plan to keep scanning.
scanErrors.importInvalidSarif: The imported file is not a valid SARIF document.
scanErrors.importTooLarge: The imported file is too large: 50 MB uploaded or 200 MB decompressed at most.
scanErrors.importTooManyResults: The imported file holds more than 100,000 results.
scanErrors.importTooManyRuns: The imported file holds more than 20 runs.
scanErrors.importStorageUnavailable: The imported file could not be read from storage. Please import it again.
scanErrors.importUnavailable: The results could not be queued for processing. Please import the file again.
scanErrors.importTimeout: The import did not finish in time. Please import the file again.
scanErrors.importInternalError: An unexpected error occurred while importing the results. Please import the file again.
scanErrors.importUnsupportedResult: A result of this import lacks its package name or installed version, so nothing was imported. Produce the file with Trivy, Grype or osv-scanner.
scanErrors.importInvalidSbom: The SBOM sent with this import is not a CycloneDX JSON document (1.4 to 1.7) it can read, so nothing was imported. Produce it with trivy fs --format cyclonedx, Syft or cdxgen.
scanErrors.importFailed: The import failed. Please check the file and import it again.
scanErrors.import: The import failed. Please check the file and import it again.
scanErrors.clusterNoResults: The scanner finished on the cluster but sent no results. Please retry; if it persists, check the scanner pod's logs.
scanErrors.clusterUnschedulable: The scanner could not be scheduled on the cluster within 10 minutes. Check the namespace's quotas and the nodes' free resources.
scanErrors.clusterDeadline: The scanner did not finish in time on the cluster. Please retry.
scanErrors.clusterLaunchFailed: The scanner could not be launched on the cluster. Check this instance's access to the scanner namespace.
scanErrors.clusterImageIncompatible: The scanner image does not support this instance. Set CYBEDEFEND_SCANNER_IMAGE_TAG to a scanner version this instance supports.
scanErrors.clusterToolFailed: The scanning tool failed on the cluster. Please retry; if it persists, check the scanner pod's logs.
scanErrors.clusterResultsRefused: The scanner's results were refused by this instance. Please retry.
scanErrors.clusterPodLost: The scanner pod disappeared from the cluster before sending its results. Please retry.
scanErrors.clusterArchiveFetchFailed: A scanner pod could not download the scan's archive from this instance's storage. Check that the storage address given to the pods (CYBEDEFEND_STORAGE_PUBLIC_URL) is reachable from the cluster, then scan again.
scanErrors.cluster: The scan could not run on the cluster. Please retry.
scanErrors.archiveTooLarge: The uploaded archive is larger than this instance accepts, so it was not scanned. Leave out build outputs, dependencies and binaries, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveTooManyEntries: The uploaded archive holds more files than this instance accepts, so it was not scanned. Leave out build outputs and dependencies, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveEntryTooLarge: A file in the uploaded archive is larger than this instance accepts, so the archive was not scanned. Leave out large generated or binary files, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveInflatedTooLarge: The uploaded archive is larger uncompressed than this instance accepts, so it was not scanned. Leave out build outputs, dependencies and binaries, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveInvalid: The uploaded file is not a readable ZIP archive, so it was not scanned. Upload a ZIP of the source code, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveEmpty: The uploaded archive holds no file, so there was nothing to scan. Upload a ZIP that contains the source code, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveEncrypted: The uploaded archive is password-protected, so it could not be scanned. Upload an archive without a password, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveUnsafePath: A file in the uploaded archive has a path that points outside the archive, so it was not scanned. Create the archive again from the project's folder, then scan again.
scanErrors.archiveNotReceived: No archive was uploaded before the upload deadline, so the scan could not start. Start the scan again.
scanErrors.archive: The uploaded archive was refused by this instance, so it was not scanned.
scanErrors.authentication: Registry authentication failed. Check the credential.
scanErrors.cloudProvider: The cloud registry rejected access. Check the credential and its permissions.
scanErrors.network: Network error reaching the registry. Please retry.
scanErrors.scan: The scanner could not read the image. Verify the image and tag.
scanErrors.api: Internal error reporting the scan result. Please retry.
scanErrors.infra: The scan could not run. Please retry; contact support if it persists.
scanErrors.generic: The scan failed. Please retry or contact support if the issue persists.
